title: Rendered emails carry their attachments
items: Rendering a captured email in an inbound provider's shape (`POST /api/requests/{id}/render`, the CLI's tunnel, `render_email`) includes its attachments' contents, up to 1 MB: Mailgun and SendGrid post an email with text attachments (CSV, JSON, XML, text) as multipart/form-data with a file part each, and Postmark and CloudMailin carry them in their JSON. The same goes for Mailgun and SendGrid destinations whose attachments are inline. A binary file (a PDF, an image) is left out of the two forms, since a form part cannot carry it as text without most parsers handing on base64; its link stays in the email's JSON
Forwarding in the Mailgun and SendGrid shapes sends attachments the destination sends inline as file parts too
Codes and links found in an email keep verify and sign-in links on GitHub, Discord and help or support hosts, and order tracking links
The changelog lists SDK 1.32.0 and the Python and Go SDKs 0.11.0
